capabilities.name: Card network agent credential
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent pay a merchant with a card network's agent token (Visa, Mastercard, Amex)?

US.note: Mastercard said it would enable all US cardholders for Agent Pay by late 2025, and Visa says Visa Intelligent Commerce is rolled out across many agents with live transactions; Amex launched its ACE kit and agent purchase protection in April 2026. We found no Mastercard or Visa source saying every US cardholder can use it today, and Mastercard's September 2026 release gives no rollout numbers. In October 2026 we re-checked Mastercard's 2025 and September 2026 releases and Visa's December 2025 and April 2026 releases: Mastercard's CEO said in October 2025 that Citi and U.S. Bank cardholders could use Agent Pay (reported by Digital Commerce 360), and Visa's April 2026 release says live transactions are taking place, but no primary source says the Mastercard rollout to all US cardholders was completed. We keep 'live' on the Citi, U.S. Bank and Visa evidence; 'limited' is the fallback if that is judged too strong.

capabilities.name: Agent pays over instant rail
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent send a payment for you over the country's instant-payment rail?

US.note: No agent payments over FedNow or RTP found; the Fed's 2026 FedNow work covers cross-border transfers, not agents.

evidence.title: Federal Reserve Board invites public comment on proposal that would allow U.S. banks and credit unions to use intermediaries to transfer funds through the FedNow Service

GB.note: No live agent payment over Faster Payments or VRP found; GoCardless's 'first UK agentic bank payment' set up a Direct Debit (not Faster Payments) inside the FCA AI Live Testing programme, TrueLayer is only testing agent-started Pay by Bank payments in the FCA sandbox until the end of 2026, and HM Treasury is still consulting on agent payment rules.

evidence.title: TrueLayer selected for FCA's Supercharged Sandbox to test agentic payments
GoCardless processes the first agentic account-to-account payment in the UK
HM Treasury Proposes Major Overhaul of UK Payments Regulation

DE.note: No agent payments over SEPA Instant or Wero found; Wero is live for people in Germany but has no agent feature.

evidence.title: N26 expands instant payment offer with introduction of European digital payment solution Wero

BR.note: Nubank's AI assistant sends Pix from text or voice for all app users, Mercado Pago's Mago assistant sends Pix, and Iniciador put a Pix agent-payments MCP into production; the user still confirms each payment.

evidence.title: Pix com Inteligência Artificial agora no App e WhatsApp do Nu
Assistente de IA do Mercado Pago: como funciona e como usar
Iniciador launches Brazil's first agentic payments MCP on Pix

MX.note: Mercado Pago's Mago assistant prepares transfers in Mexico that the user confirms, and Mercado Pago connects directly to SPEI; we searched Mercado Pago's Mexico blog, help center and developer pages again in October 2026 but found no page that says Mago sends to a CLABE or over SPEI, and the press only says Mago 'does transfers'. Lowered from live because the SPEI link is unproven.

evidence.title: Asistente personal de Mercado Pago: qué es y para qué sirve

CL.note: Mercado Pago's Mago assistant arrived in Chile in September 2026 and prepares transfers that the user confirms; we searched Mercado Pago Chile's site, help center and newsroom in October 2026 but found no official page that says Mago sends money to other banks over TEF, and the Chile rollout reach is not stated. Mercado Pago's September 2026 Chile release says Mago prepares transfers and needs user confirmation, but no page names the TEF rail.

evidence.title: Mercado Pago lanzó Mago, su asistente con IA para gestionar finanzas y negocios
Mago llega a Chile: el asistente personal de Mercado Pago

CO.note: Tpaga launched a WhatsApp AI agent that sends money over Bre-B from text or voice notes; it is one fintech and its rollout scope is not stated. In October 2026 we checked Tpaga's website and Banco de la República's Bre-B page and searched for Nequi, Daviplata, Bancolombia and Mercado Pago agents, but found no primary source for an agent on Bre-B. Banco de la República's Bre-B page shows the rail is live with 245 entities but does not mention AI agents.

evidence.title: Tpaga lanzó el primer agente de inteligencia artificial en Colombia para pagar
Bre-B: sistema de pagos inmediatos interoperable

IN.note: NPCI, Razorpay and OpenAI run a private beta for UPI payments inside ChatGPT using UPI Reserve Pay, and Amazon Pay launched an agentic UPI Smart Wallet at GFF 2026; NPCI's agent protocol has no public go-live date.

companies.role: The Mago AI agent makes payments and transfers (including Pix in Brazil) for users after they confirm.
